hook.name: SlowmoFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-sensitive ETH fee hook for Uniswap v4 pools opened by SlowmoLaunch. Charges a dynamic fee (1%–7%) on buys via beforeSwap delta and on sells via afterSwap delta, scaling the fee based on the previous swap's tick movement. Fees are pushed immediately to a per-pool feeRecipient; pool creation is gated to a bound factory contract.
